mapper.select: select * from notificationManagement where notificationManagementBannerBoo = 1 and notificationManagementBoo != 0
select categoryStateMinorText from categoryStateMinor where categoryStateMinorCode = #{code};
mapper.insert: insert into JGNotice( JGNoticeTitle, JGNoticeText, JGNoticeProductPrice, JGNoticeProductTypeMajor, JGNoticeProductTypeMinor, JGNoticeProductTypeMinorList, userCode ) value( #{JGNoticeTitle}, #{JGNoticeText}, #{JGNoticeProductPrice}, #{JGNoticeProductTypeMajor}, #{JGNoticeProductTypeMinor}, #{JGNoticeProductTypeMinorList}, #{userCode} );
mapper.select: select JGNoticeUpdate from JGNotice where userCode = #{code} and JGNoticeSaleBoo = 1 order by JGNoticeUpdate desc limit 0 ,1
select count(*) from JGNotice where userCode = #{code} and JGNoticeSaleBoo = 1;
select * from jgnotice where JGNoticeCreate between DATE_SUB(now(), interval 7 DAY) AND now() order by JGNoticeCreate desc limit 0 ,12;
